Bear Cove Ln, Richwoods Township, MO 63071, USA 

## Experiences 

### About this location 

Twisted Minds Haunted House, located on Bear Cove Lane in Richwoods Township, offers an adrenaline-pumping experience for thrill-seekers. Visitors can explore 16 eerie mobile homes haunted by a sinister ghost, as well as embark on a spine-tingling ride on the haunted hayride, promising an unforgettable night of terror and excitement. Parking details are not provided, but guests are encouraged to prepare for an immersive adventure at this unique haunted attraction in Richwoods.

When is Haunted Hollows Haunted Trail in Palmyra, Missouri Open?

# When is Haunted Hollows Haunted Trail in Palmyra, Missouri Open?

Brian MylesPublished: September 26, 2013

Johannes Simon, Getty Images

Haunted Hollows Haunted Trail is ready for another spooky Halloween season just south of Palmyra, Missouri.

The trail will be open Friday and Saturday nights in October. It is open each night from 7:30 to 11 p.m. [Editor's note: We apologize for an error in our initial version of this story. We accidentally published dates from last year's event.]

Tickets go on sale on location at 7:30 p.m. at a cost of $8 per person. Children under 13 must be accompanied by an adult.

According to the Haunted Hollows facebook page, a lot of new props are being added this year including new structures and bridges. They promise 'bigger scares and more bang for your buck'

To find Haunted Hollows Haunted Trail take Highway 61 south from Palmyra, or north from Hannibal. Turn onto Highway F and follow the signs.

In 1992, the building was transformed once more into Phantom Theater, replacing the ride's waterways with an Omnimover-style system of transport. It was themed as a behind-the-scenes tour of a haunted theater. The theme and ride vehicles were changed over the years – Scooby Doo and the Haunted Castle in 2003 and Boo Blasters on Boo Hill in 2010 – but the same underlying transportation system was retained each time. In 2026, Kings Island will open Phantom Theater: Opening Nightmare, a revival of the original Phantom Theater attraction with modern technology and interactive elements not found in the original ride.

The area's main attractions include the Royal Fountain, a 600000gal capable of shooting 10000gal of water into the air each minute, and the signature Eiffel Tower, a one-third scale replica of the original which offers a view of the entire park to its guests. Grand Carousel, a classic carousel built in 1926 and originally located at Coney Island, is another International Street attraction. Also located here is Kings Island Theater along with a variety of restaurants and souvenir shops.
